issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors - 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' causing entire root to switch to client rendering. This typically happens when time-based content (like 'Good evening' greeting or 'Thursday, April 16' date) is rendered on the server with different values than client, or when browser extensions modify DOM.
issues.element: Greeting text 'Good evening, Amelia.' and/or date 'Thursday, April 16'
issues.root_cause: The greeting ('Good morning/afternoon/evening') and/or date are computed at render time using new Date() without being wrapped in a useEffect or using suppressHydrationWarning, causing server/client mismatch.

issues.description: Style Profile radar chart section expected per EXPECTED BEHAVIOR but not visible in screenshot - either missing from layout or rendered below visible area without proper scroll indicator.
issues.root_cause: Radar chart component may not be rendered in the dashboard page, or it's positioned below the fold without visibility.

issues.description: Third room card title 'Dining Room Curatio...' is truncated in the card - this may be intentional CSS truncation but worth verifying the full title renders correctly.
issues.root_cause: CSS text overflow truncation on room card title element.

fixes.reason: Placeholder - see actual fix below for dynamic greeting
Move time-based greeting computation to useEffect to avoid SSR/client hydration mismatch. Server always renders 'Good evening' as default, client updates after mount.

fixes.new_str: {typeof window !== 'undefined' ? new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }) : ''}
fixes.reason: Suppress hydration warning for dynamically computed date string that will differ between server and client renders.
